fields.name: name
fields.meaning: Display name of the file activity.

fields.name: intro
fields.meaning: Description (intro), optionally shown above the file (pseudofield "printintro" controls whether it is shown; only effective for certain display values).

fields.name: display
fields.meaning: File display (e.g. automatic, embedded, new window, popup, direct open/download). Available options are a subset configured by Moodle administration, not a fixed list.

value_range.source: lib/resourcelib.php:30-42 (RESOURCELIB_DISPLAY_*-constants), :111 (resourcelib_get_displayoptions()); Subset from admin_setting_configmultiselect('resource/displayoptions', ...) in mod/resource/settings.php:28-42; column mod/resource/db/install.xml (resource.display)

fields.name: filterfiles
fields.meaning: Apply text filters to file content: no filter (0), all files (1), or HTML files only (2).

pseudofields.name: files
pseudofields.type: List of material store paths (JSON array)
pseudofields.meaning: Files to attach, including the main file - each entry is a path in the material store (Spec 0018 §4.2, e.g. ["worksheet.pdf"]), uploaded there first using upload_material_file. REQUIRED FIELD: WITHOUT a main file, resource creates a broken activity page - unlike folder, an empty state is invalid here.

value_range.source: mod/resource/locallib.php: resource_set_mainfile(); mod/resource/view.php:69-71 (resource_print_filenotfound() without a file); local_coursepilot\material_files::resolve_into_draft()

pseudofields.name: printintro
pseudofields.meaning: Show intro as well - only effective for display=0 (auto), 1 (embed) or 2 (frame). Not a DB field - stored in the serialized "displayoptions" column.

value_range.source: mod/resource/lib.php (resource_set_display_options(): only set when display in [AUTO, EMBED, FRAME])

pseudofields.name: popupwidth
pseudofields.meaning: Window width in pixels, only effective for display=6 (popup). Not a DB field - stored in "displayoptions".

pseudofields.name: popupheight
pseudofields.meaning: Window height in pixels, only effective for display=6 (popup). Not a DB field - stored in "displayoptions".

pseudofields.name: showsize
pseudofields.meaning: Dateigroesse anzeigen. Kein DB-Feld - fliesst in "displayoptions".

pseudofields.name: showtype
pseudofields.meaning: Dateityp anzeigen. Kein DB-Feld - fliesst in "displayoptions".

pseudofields.name: showdate
pseudofields.meaning: Show file creation/modification date. Not a DB field - stored in "displayoptions".

side_effects: resource requires "files" on creation (list of material store paths, Spec 0018 §4.2): without a main file, the activity page is broken (Spec 0015 §4.3), so create_module fails without "files" before anything is created.
